author: Home Repair Tutor
description: SharkBite PEX A water supply line tips…I’m using 1/2 inch SharkBite PEX A with expansion rings. I do 5 to 6 expansions of the tubing and ring then slide them onto the PEX A fittings. This is a strong and fast way to run new water lines. Many thanks to SharkBite for sponsoring this tutorial #sharkbiteplumbing #plumbing #diy #sponsored
